scope: Pre-publication scan of current GitHub-visible source histories and all available CI/comment surfaces; not a security proof or hardware qualification

git.reviewed_false_positive: Exact pinned ESP-IDF public default for disabled OpenThread module; source scoped, no live operator key

github.reviewed_false_positives: Every match is a 64-hex source-file SHA-256 in firmware.json, not a credential

operator_password_screenshot_review: Masked or empty entry; no password disclosed
limitations: Pattern matching is not proof that all unknown secret formats or vulnerabilities are absent.
Raw logs and redacted reports are private and excluded from Git.
New commits, runs, comments and artifacts require scanning too.
